description: The review. The verdict follows from the findings: any critical or important finding means changes are needed.

summary.description: two or three plain sentences: does the change fix the issue as specified, and what matters most

risk.description: high if the change touches risky ground (see your instructions), else low

line.description: a line in the new version of the file that the PR changed

problem.description: what is wrong, in one or two sentences

scenario.description: concrete input or state, and the wrong result or crash
